Reload the big collection: **http://maker:4001/?demo=big**

- Click **"Show more"** — the full, formatted note appears (bold, bullets), and the link becomes **"Show less."**

**Please check the large-collection handling (edge case 5):**
- It now shows **20 at a time** with a count like **"200 bookmarks"** and **"Showing 20 of 200"**, plus a **Load more** button — click it to reveal the next 20.

Two small assumptions to confirm:
- **20 per page** as the starting amount, and **"Load more"** (rather than numbered pages) — good for now? (Your ability to *change* the default page size and default sort is recorded for the later preferences cycle.)
- Clamping to **~2 lines for title/description** and a short note preview — is that the right amount to show before "Show more"?
